html.content:
Recommended

Linescore: 0.95

Connected points showing trends over a continuous or ordinal axis.

Clinical use: Lab values over visits, PK concentration-time profiles

  • time + numeric → trend line
  • colour by category
  • enough time points

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='line chart of <numeric> over <time> colored by <factor>'

Best for showing trends of a numeric value over a

Alternatives

Barscore: 1.0

Vertical or horizontal bars comparing values across categories.

Clinical use: AE counts by SOC/arm, subject counts by group

  • 1+ category + 1+ numeric
  • exactly 1 cat, 1 num — classic bar
  • small-medium dataset
  • manageable category count

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='grouped bar chart of <metric> by <category>'

Densityscore: 0.85

Smooth kernel density estimate — overlay multiple groups.

Clinical use: Overlaid PK distributions across arms

  • 1+ numeric → density estimate
  • overlay groups by category
  • enough n for smooth density

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='density plot of <numeric> grouped by <factor>'

Boxplotscore: 0.8

Box-and-whisker showing median, IQR, and outliers per group.

Clinical use: Lab value distributions by arm/visit, PK endpoints

  • cat + numeric → distribution by group
  • sufficient n for box stats

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='boxplot of <numeric> grouped by <factor>'

Violinscore: 0.8

Kernel density mirrored around a centre line — richer shape than boxplot.

Clinical use: Biomarker distributions, gene expression by cell type

  • cat + numeric → distribution shape
  • enough data for density estimate

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='violin plot of <numeric> by <factor>'
